title: Locating the Hostnames and IP Addresses for Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: To locate the hostnames and IP addresses of the Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) for your IPSec VPN tunnels:

blocks.item: You can find the name of your cloud in the URL your admins used to log in to the Zscaler service. For example, if an organization logs in to admin.zscalertwo.net, then that organization's cloud name is zscalertwo.net. So, you should go to config.zscaler.com/zscalertwo.net/cenr. To learn more, see Understanding Zscaler Cloud Names.
Go to Cloud Enforcement Node Ranges.

Under VPN Host Name, find the two data centers closest to the organization's location. Choose one as the destination for your primary IPSec VPN tunnel and the other as the destination for your backup IPSec VPN tunnel.

For example, if you're located in London, scroll to the EMEA section of the table to find lon3-vpn.zscaler.net (London) as your primary destination and ams3-vpn.zscaler.net (Amsterdam) as your backup destination.
If you need the IP addresses of the Public Service Edges, resolve the hostnames of your primary and backup destinations.
